name: Chinese artemisinin discovery
description: Tu Youyou’s team identified artemisinin in 1972 in research informed by earlier Chinese medical literature.

date.basis: Date refers to this scoped event or archaeological context, not to a global origin.

events.statement: Tu Youyou’s team identified artemisinin in 1972 in research informed by earlier Chinese medical literature.

evidence.supports: Tu recounts how historical Chinese medical literature informed the research, and dates the team’s identification of artemisinin to November 1972. Her account separates the 1972 plant-extract clinical trial from the first artemisinin clinical trial in 1973 and describes collaboration across teams.

events.caveats: The team’s 1972 clinical observations concerned an earlier plant extract; the cited lecture dates an artemisinin clinical trial to 1973. Modern clinical use and access require separate evidence.
